text:
sneha: Canary restore failing in staging for snapshot s-20260321-01. Restore task logs: "AccessDenied: Missing grant for CMK alias/snapshot-cmk". I inspected object metadata: when we uploaded earlier snapshots we had header "x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd" but new objects show "x-cloud-meta-cmk": "null". Potential metadata-normalization bug in new uploader push. /cc @maria @raj

maria: ugh. did the uploader migration go out last night? I remember a job to normalize metadata for multi-cloud support

raj: yes infra rollout rolled out uploader v2 at 00:50Z. PR infra#4620 replaced S3-specific headers with a canonical x-cloud-meta-* set. Looks like KMS metadata got lost in translation and grants were created for the old principal name too (we did a role rename in infra#4582 earlier). link: https://git.internal/infra/pulls/4620

ben: double-bad then: grant principal mismatch + metadata header change. I pulled KMS audit: CreateGrant happened (2026-03-22T00:55Z) for principal arn:aws:iam::111111111:role/snapshot-uploader-old and we now try decrypt with role/snapshot-uploader-new. Grant list for alias/snapshot-cmk doesn't include new role. Also object metadata missing the KMS key id, so restore path can't even infer CMK in some cases. audit-id: kms-audit-512

encops-bot: Alert: 3 failed canary restores in last 15m for staging (snapshots s-20260321-01..03). Related: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied.

sneha: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Recreate grants on snapshot CMK for the new role and short TTL (team-approved) 2) Backfill object metadata where missing from backup manifest (manifest contains original key ids) and re-run restores 3) Rollback uploader v2 if failures keep spiking

maria: agree. start with grants so customers stop seeing errors. ben can you run create-grant? once restores are green we can do a non-urgent backfill job and patch uploader to preserve x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id header for S3 uploads

ben: running now (will post commands). also adding a small safety CI that flags role rename PRs without a delegated alias in infra repo.

ben: running commands:
```
# as ops-admin
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/snapshot-cmk \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111:role/snapshot-uploader-new \
  --operations "Encrypt" "Decrypt" "GenerateDataKey" \
  --name "temp-restore-grant-512999" \
  --constraints "{\"EncryptionContextSubset\":{\"purpose\":\"snapshot-restore\"}}" 
```

ben: grant created id=g-0a1b2c3d ttl=7d

sneha: kicked off a manifest-driven backfill job for the 3 affected snapshots, will monitor

raj: follow-ups: 1) add canary that validates SSE metadata preserved after uploader deploys 2) adopt role alias (snapshot-uploader@redwood) so renames don't break grants 3) patch audit playbook to check grant principal vs current uploader roles before rotations

maria: thanks all. i'll open a postmortem-lite with action owners. keeping thread open until all restores succeed :thumbsup:

encops-bot: Update: restores for s-20260321-01..03 succeeded at 2026-03-22T02:12Z (canary green)
